Package neqsim.process.examples

Class Comparesimulations2EngineeringDiagramReference

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.examples.Comparesimulations2EngineeringDiagramReference
public final class Comparesimulations2EngineeringDiagramReference extends Object
Reproducible full-model engineering-diagram reference for the comparesimulations2.ipynb separation and compression case.

The runnable NeqSim model is authoritative. The historical notebook illustration is context only, so the illustrated 24-VB-01 is deliberately not added when it is absent from the canonical process. The generated P&ID remains a teaching proposal requiring project, discipline, and safety review.
